en: A colorized winter cityscape shows a street and tram line descending between snow‑covered trees toward a small square. In the middle distance stands a cylindrical red‑brick tower with a conical, snow‑covered roof and an attached lighter building. Further back rises a distinctive church with an onion‑shaped golden dome and lantern. People and an old tram are visible on the street, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European city.
